semantics.majority: Candidate0, votes=histo[0]; scan bins1..n_bins-1 ascending; update only histo[i]>votes. Empty population writes0. Static disjoint neighborhoods share modal output but API signatures and mutation/provider contracts are independently frozen.
semantics.otsu: Population is float64; weighted total and q1/mu1/mu2 are Py_ssize_t. q1 starts histo[0]. Skip zero bins. Add P to q1, break if q1==pop, then add i*P to mu1. t=(pop-q1)*mu1-mu2*q1; score=t*t/(q1*(pop-q1)). Strict score>best initialized0 retains earliest positive-score occupied bin. Empty and one occupied bin yield0.
semantics.dimensions: Both wrappers dispatch2D/3D; 2D shift_x/shift_y maps center columns/rows and ignores shift_z. 3D shifts follow array axes x/y/z. Scalar outputs use squeeze2D and reshape3D; final subclass hooks and pre/post writes are observable.
